svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.title: How kunlun-cli works
svg.desc: Current authorization and API call flow: the user confirms access in the browser, the local Agent invokes kunlun-cli through terminal commands, and the CLI calls the Kunlun Open Platform using the approved application permissions and user authorization. Results return to the local Agent.

svg.title: Kunlun CLI
svg.desc: A geometric robot assistant with a folded document and a cyan pencil, with a transparent background.

svg.title: kunlun-cli — geometric wordmark
svg.desc: Custom lowercase lettering. A branching k, matching geometric u and n bowls, short-footed l forms, and a chamfered command-line hyphen. Midnight blue and teal, with a transparent background. All letters are vector outlines.
